matrix.checks: (a) v in [V_lo, V_hi] at every step; (b) first valid-output crossing after s no later than s + tau, and valid at every step from s + tau to the end; also recorded: any return to invalid after the first crossing
matrix.disturbances: zero, +eps, -eps, sinusoids at 0.1, 1, 10, 50 GHz (seeded phases), seeded random PWL (knots every 0.02, 0.2 ns; uniform and +-eps extremes), adv_oppose, adv_outward, env_low, env_high
matrix.theta_C_sets: 32 corners x {C_min, C_max} + 32 seeded interior lattice points x {C_max, seeded random C}; plus the theta-free rows box_low / box_high (extremal selections of the rev. 2 inclusion, parameter point free at each instant)

ratio_hist.note: runs whose output was already valid when the input became valid (delay 0) are excluded from the bins and counted in per_polarity.n_already_valid_at_s
